name: What features should be included when designing an in-law suite for aging relatives?
description: Prioritize ground-floor access, wider doorways, zero-threshold walk-in showers, reinforced grab bars, slip-resistant tile, and bright, accessible lighting.

mainEntity.name: What features should be included when designing an in-law suite for aging relatives?

acceptedAnswer.text: Key design features include curbless walk-in showers, wider doorways, grab-bar reinforcement, level flooring transitions, and low-maintenance surfaces. Converting a tub to a barrier-free shower with slip-resistant tile and hand-held fixtures significantly improves safety for older relatives. It is also beneficial to place the suite on the ground floor with a dedicated exterior entry, lever-style door hardware, and ample task lighting. Planning these functional details early ensures the space remains safe, comfortable, and adaptable for years without requiring future corrective remodeling.
